intended_use: Schema/contract planning and future independent-verifier fixtures; not physical validation, a permit, a design approval, or a safety certification.

scenarios.setup: Parcel has partial mapped coverage and no qualified subsurface report.
required_invariants: Unknown coverage never means safe.
Foundation conclusions remain blocked until required ground evidence is accepted.

scenarios.setup: A confirmed hard flood/drainage exclusion intersects the proposed building footprint.
required_invariants: A soft preference score cannot override a confirmed hard constraint.

scenarios.setup: Two shading/orientation variants have complete synthetic inputs and outputs from one named model profile.
required_invariants: Report model identity, units, uncertainty and limitations.
Comparison does not certify physical performance.

scenarios.setup: Declared irrigation plus household demand exceeds the bounded water source under the drought scenario.
required_invariants: Reconcile sources, storage, demand, losses and time horizon.
Do not double count shared water.

scenarios.setup: Heatwave and grid outage exceed the declared essential-load energy envelope before the requested duration.
required_invariants: Report duration and service floors per essential load.
Rated capacity is not delivered-service evidence.

scenarios.setup: A required treatment or wastewater dependency is missing during source interruption.
required_invariants: Serial bottlenecks bound delivery.
Unknown water quality is not potable supply.

scenarios.setup: Network/cloud outage disables an essential function and no tested local/manual fallback is declared.
required_invariants: Essential functions preserve user control and fallback.
Cloud reachability is not local operability.

scenarios.setup: A furniture revision blocks a resident-selected circulation task or a required egress route.
required_invariants: Furniture changes invalidate affected topology/task results.
Room-area totals alone do not prove access.

scenarios.setup: A proposed planting/landscape option conflicts with a confirmed ecological no-go area or declared fire/water constraint.
required_invariants: Use separately sourced specialist evidence.
No universal green-score override.

scenarios.setup: A required pump/filter/battery/valve replacement cannot be reached or isolated under the declared task sequence.
required_invariants: Modularity counts only when the replacement task is feasible.
Report tools, spares, isolation and downtime assumptions.

scenarios.setup: A supplier substitution changes a product or material bound to a previously reviewed design revision.
required_invariants: Preserve old approval as history only.
Re-evaluate affected assumptions and receipts.

scenarios.setup: Installed geometry or equipment differs from the accepted design and dependent checks have not been rerun.
required_invariants: No stale approval upgrades to current acceptance.
Commissioning compares intended, installed, measured and accepted states.

scenarios.setup: Separate residents hold conflicting preferences and the decision authority/priority disposition is unresolved.
required_invariants: Do not infer preferences from demographic proxies.
Do not average away a mandatory task or unresolved dissent.

scenarios.setup: A proposed storm safe-room profile lacks required egress, ventilation, fire or qualified shelter-engineering evidence.
required_invariants: No safe-room claim from generic resilience evidence.
Scope is limited to named hazard and jurisdiction.

scenarios.setup: A request concerns a specialized hazard outside the model's declared validated scope.
required_invariants: Never extrapolate storm-shelter evidence into another hazard class.
Require specialist requirements and professional review.

scenarios.setup: Cost, time, supplier availability or embodied-impact values are absent or only scenario bounds.
required_invariants: Do not impute unknowns as zero.
Preserve units, ranges, currency and evidence origin.

scenarios.setup: A tiny frozen design space has complete synthetic hard constraints and a known feasible/Pareto set.
required_invariants: Production selector matches independent exhaustive outcomes.
Deterministic tie handling and input-order invariance.

scenarios.setup: A high-impact source, geometry or model revision changes dependencies of prior analysis outputs.
required_invariants: All declared dependent outputs require revalidation.
Unrelated outputs may be reused only if dependency rules justify it.

scenarios.setup: The proposed smart-home architecture grants a compromised third-party cloud credential cross-subsystem control; after unauthorized changes, the resident network is disconnected and essential fallback has not been demonstrated.
required_invariants: Remote or cloud identity compromise must not grant unbounded control across independent building subsystems.
Essential functions retain the declared local/manual fallback and authorized override during disconnection.
The test fixture is synthetic; it does not establish penetration-test coverage or physical security.
